user.title: Water heater
user.description: The entities Home Assistant already has for the water heater, and the tank. The integration only reads them: it never switches the heater.

data_description.relay_entity: The switch that powers the heater.
data_description.power_entity: The power the heater draws (W or kW).
data_description.energy_entity: Optional: the heater's cumulative energy meter. Without it, the energy is computed from the power.
data_description.hot_water_entity: Optional: a cumulative meter of the hot water leaving the tank (L or m³), before any mixing valve. Without it, draws are seen only through the heating that follows.
data_description.losses_w: Heat the tank loses while idle (about 95 W for a 200 L tank).
data_description.cold_water_c: Temperature of the water entering the tank.
data_description.learn_losses: Count the losses measured between two full tanks without any draw (12 h at least) in place of the standing losses above. Measured in any case (the Learned losses sensor); off, the estimate counts the standing losses above.

reconfigure.title: Water heater entities
reconfigure.description: The entities read. The tank's parameters and the estimate stay; a replaced meter is counted from its first reading.

missing_relay_entity.title: The relay of {name} no longer exists
missing_relay_entity.description: The relay {entity} of the water heater {name} no longer exists (renamed, or its device removed): its hot water level is unavailable. To choose its replacement, reconfigure the water heater: *Settings* > *Devices & services* > *Smart Hass - Water Heater* > ⋮ > *Reconfigure*.

missing_power_entity.title: The heater power of {name} no longer exists
missing_power_entity.description: The heater power {entity} of the water heater {name} no longer exists (renamed, or its device removed): its hot water level is unavailable. To choose its replacement, reconfigure the water heater: *Settings* > *Devices & services* > *Smart Hass - Water Heater* > ⋮ > *Reconfigure*.

missing_energy_entity.title: The heater energy meter of {name} no longer exists
missing_energy_entity.description: The heater energy meter {entity} of the water heater {name} no longer exists (renamed, or its device removed): its heating is no longer counted. To choose its replacement or remove it, reconfigure the water heater: *Settings* > *Devices & services* > *Smart Hass - Water Heater* > ⋮ > *Reconfigure*.

missing_hot_water_entity.title: The hot water meter of {name} no longer exists
missing_hot_water_entity.description: The hot water meter {entity} of the water heater {name} no longer exists (renamed, or its device removed): its draws are no longer counted. To choose its replacement or remove it, reconfigure the water heater: *Settings* > *Devices & services* > *Smart Hass - Water Heater* > ⋮ > *Reconfigure*.
